DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_id as "planId", plan_order_id as "id", plan_order_type_id as "planOrderTypeId", plan_order_order as "planOrderOrder", next_plan_order_id as "nextPlanOrderId", next_plan_id as "nextPlanId", alias as "alias", description as "description", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_orders WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_orders (plan_id, plan_order_id, plan_order_type_id, plan_order_order, next_plan_order_id, next_plan_id, alias, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:planId, :id=getNextId{'conf.plan_orders'$'plan_order_id'$'plan_id=planId'}, :planOrderTypeId, :planOrderOrder, :nextPlanOrderId, :nextPlanId, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plan_orders SET plan_order_type_id = :planOrderTypeId, plan_order_order = :planOrderOrder, next_plan_order_id = :nextPlanOrderId, next_plan_id = :nextPlanId, alias = :alias, description = :description, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :id
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.plan_orders WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :id
